janaf_printed.identity: Neutral P4S3 ideal gas; legacy table specifies stoichiometry/phase but no structural-isomer model.
janaf_printed.construction: Both formation enthalpy and heat capacity/entropy are explicitly estimated.

kroeger_karton2019.access: Complete accepted author manuscript inspected, Sections 3.2/3.3 and Tables 1/3/5.
kroeger_karton2019.identity: Isolated P4S3 molecular cage; no condensed lattice enthalpy.
kroeger_karton2019.preferred_cycle: P4S3 + 0.5 S2 -> 2 P2S2, using W4 fragment anchors and W3lite-F12 reaction energy.
kroeger_karton2019.thermal_construction: B3LYP-D3/Def2-TZVPP geometry and harmonic frequencies; zero-point energies scaled by 0.99. Detailed frequency/geometry supplement not acquired in this review.
kroeger_karton2019.caution: Atomization route is explicitly less converged; its quoted uncertainty is not a preferred-cycle error bar. Cycle spread is method sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

elemental_reference.compatibility: The 2019 paper uses CODATA elemental heat contents; the selected JANAF atomic tables imply the same phase-specific increments. The modern atomic Hf values differ and must not be silently mixed.
